frozen_mixed.rule: at least 1 above the Semaev value 5; 5 is F5

metrics.mixed_block_interpretation: x_k = sum_{i<6} c_{k,i} a_i with ALL six digit variables shared across k=1,2 (c uniform in [1,p-1]); the literal 3-shared-variable reading makes ell_1^2 ell_2^2 vanish (degree 4 > 3 variables) and is degenerate, recorded not run
